paper_title: Dual Modality-Aware Gated Prompt Tuning for Few-Shot Multimodal Sarcasm   Detection
caption: Effect of Prompt Length
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the relationship between prompt length and accuracy for two models. The x-axis represents prompt length on a linear scale, ranging from 2 to 16, with tick labels at regular intervals of 2. The y-axis represents accuracy on a linear scale, ranging from 77 to 81. The plot shows two lines: one in red with circular markers and a solid line style, representing "mmsd"; and one in yellow with circular markers and a solid line style, representing "mmsd2". The red line starts at approximately 80.5 at a prompt length of 2 and decreases to approximately 80.25 at a prompt length of 4, then increases to approximately 80.5 at a prompt length of 8, and remains steady until decreasing slightly to approximately 80 at a prompt length of 16. The yellow line starts at approximately 77.5 at a prompt length of 2, decreases to approximately 76.5 at a prompt length of 4, increases to approximately 78 at a prompt length of 8, and then declines steadily to approximately 76.5 at a prompt length of 16.
